articles.summary: DALLAS, TX (September 9. 2026)— MarineMax Dallas is partnering with Cars & Coffee to host “Yachts, Cars & Coffee: Honor Our Heroes,” a free community event honoring the Combat Veterans Motorcycle Association® (CVMA®) TX 23-1. The event takes place Saturday, September 12, 2026, from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. at MarineMa
